reference.quote: high power lasers that are characterised by a combination of power at the output apertures (values of 1 kilowatt and above), beam quality (M^2 of less than 1.2), intended operating ranges (greater than 1 kilometre)
reference.value: lasers >= 1 kW, M^2 < 1.2, range > 1 km, typically 1-2 micrometre wavelengths (scope of sector 8)

reference.quote: continuous silicon carbide fibres with diameters at and below 140 micrometres
continuous oxide-based ceramic fibres with diameters at or below 20 micrometres
magnets utilising rare earth element-lean or element-free permanent magnetic materials with remanent magnetism, known as “Br”, greater than 1.0 Tesla
in batches of at least 1 kilogram
reference.value: solid-state oxide reduction in batches >= 1 kg

reference.quote: titanium alloys with continuous temperature-of-use capabilities above 350 Celsius
nickel and cobalt based superalloys with continuous temperature-of-use capabilities above 700 Celsius
steels for power transmission shafts with yield strengths of at least 1030 megapascals at 20 Celsius
reference.value: shaft steels: yield >= 1030 MPa at 20 C and 760 MPa at 450 C, UTS >= 1240/950 MPa, toughness >= 40 MPa m^0.5

reference.quote: alloys that are formed by five or more elements
rare earth element-lean or element-free permanent magnetic materials with remanent magnetisation (also known as “Br”), greater than 1.0 Tesla
reference.value: magnetic materials Br > 1.0 T (materials list, separate from para. 2)

reference.quote: magnetic materials with high total saturation flux densities greater than 2.0 Tesla
engineering polymer materials and formulations with a glass transition temperature greater than 190 Celsius
polymer electrical insulation materials with high temperature (greater than 200 Celsius) and high voltage (above 1kilovolt))
adhesives capable of retaining performance at high temperatures (above 190 Celsius)
ultra-high temperature ceramics (with melting temperatures of at least 3000 Celsius)
magnetic materials, including fibres and particulates, for electromagnetic applications at frequencies above 500 megahertz
functional ceramics (including ferroelectrics, magneto-dielectrics, or multi-ferroics) for acoustic applications, or electromagnetic applications above 100 megahertz
high performance thermal imaging systems, equipment and components providing system sensitivity less than 30 milli-Kelvin for large format systems with more than 1 megapixels
reference.value: thermal imaging sensitivity < 30 mK and > 1 megapixel

reference.quote: single photon counting detector arrays operating at wavelengths longer than the visible band (wavelength greater than 750 nanometres), and with a size of at least 32x32 elements, or linear arrays with a size of at least 1x256 elements
reference.value: SPAD arrays > 750 nm and >= 32x32 or >= 1x256 elements

reference.quote: low noise CMOS (complementary metal-oxide-semiconductor) and EMCCD (electron multiplying charge coupled device) cameras where low noise would be less than 1 photoelectron/pixel/second
polarisation control components including materials (solid and liquid) especially for high power applications (greater than 100 watts)
phase modulators, where the spectral linewidth of fibre laser amplifiers is limited to no more than 16 gigahertz
materials suitable for aberration correction of high-power lasers (greater than 1 kilowatt) in the atmosphere
compensate for the adverse atmospheric effects on laser beam propagation at distances greater than1 kilometre
any approaches that enable high average optical power (greater than 3 kilowatts) combined with high quality (M2 <1.2) amplifiers
any aspects that enable the propagation of light over significant distances (greater than 1 kilometre)
circuit board manufacturing of pitch, track or gap dimensions less than 30 micrometres
within the range of 15 terahertz up to and including ultraviolet
reference.value: signature-modifying materials in 15 THz to UV range

The turnover condition is that the turnover of the entity’s relevant business for the relevant period is at least £50,000,000
reference.value: public electronic communications providers: UK relevant turnover >= GBP 50 million (with associated entities)

reference.quote: a person has a controlling interest in a qualifying entity if the person holds more than 50% of the shares or voting rights in the entity
reference.value: > 50% shares/votes = controlling interest (associated entities aggregated for turnover)

reference.quote: in any relevant 168-hour period, serviced 14 billion or more queries from devices located in the United Kingdom
reference.value: TLD registry >= 14 billion UK queries in a 168-hour period

reference.quote: serviced 500,000 or more different Internet Protocol addresses used by persons in the United Kingdom
reference.value: DNS resolver >= 500,000 UK IP addresses in a 168-hour period

reference.quote: providing a domain name system authoritative hosting service servicing 100,000 or more domains registered to persons with an address in the United Kingdom
has 30% or more of the market share among operators of internet exchange points in the United Kingdom
has a throughput of greater than 3,000,000 tonnes of oil equivalent over the 12 calendar months preceding the month
reference.value: existing upstream petroleum facility > 3,000,000 toe in prior 12 months

reference.quote: has an expected throughput of greater than 3,000,000 tonnes of oil equivalent in its first 12 calendar months of operation
reference.value: new upstream petroleum facility > 3,000,000 toe expected in first 12 months

reference.quote: individual generating asset that has a total installed capacity equal to or greater than 100 megawatts
the relevant capacity of the qualifying entity is equal to or greater than one gigawatt
reference.value: relevant capacity (incl. acquirer group and aggregation) >= 1 GW

reference.quote: greater than 6 million cubic metres of gas per day
the importation, regasification or liquefaction of greater than 6 million cubic metres of gas per day
has capacity of greater than 500,000 tonnes
reference.value: downstream oil: entity capacity > 500,000 tonnes in one of prior 3 calendar years

reference.quote: owns a facility in the United Kingdom that has capacity of greater than 50,000 tonnes
handled 1 million tonnes or more of cargo
reference.value: port or harbour >= 1 million tonnes cargo in preceding year

reference.quote: handled at least six million passenger movements
or 100,000 tonnes of freight in 2018

notes: X thresholds (50 items) judged by systematic sample k=2 (indices 0,2,...,48); all 25 sampled correct. Unsampled X item 49 (GBP 50m turnover) uses variable 'volume' instead of revenue_annual. X covers almost every numeric scope cutoff (49/50 reference items; misses only the >50% controlling-interest test for associated entities); Y covers the size/capacity thresholds in Schedules 5, 11, 17 but only 16 of the 29 Schedule 1 technical cutoffs. Y codes 20 per-Schedule scope descriptions as eligibility_condition obligations (judged unsupported). Both correctly mark enforcement not_applicable (sanctions are in the NSI Act 2021).
